title: Cost Modeling — Carton Quote Review
result: A repeatable check for supplier price changes
summary: Used an Excel cost model and comparisons across similarly sized carton items to evaluate whether a quoted adjustment was reasonable.
context: A price adjustment needs to be assessed against the carton specification and material inputs. Comparing unit quotations alone can miss differences between items.
decisions: I used carton dimensions and material or paper price inputs to calculate a comparable cost and cross-checked the quoted adjustment against items of similar size.
outcome: The workbook captured the calculation and recorded a judgment on whether the supplier's adjustment was reasonable based on comparable items.
